agreement: Maintainer, 3 Nov 2026: 14:40 agreement to recompile MoltenVK or replace its kept binary; 15:04 go-ahead for this workflow and its runs; 15:23 'keep the latest MoltenVK library, the most recent one'.
why: v1.4.2 (newest Khronos release) enables MTLResidencySet on iOS 18 (mvkOSVersionIsAtLeast(15.0, 18.0, 2.0), Apple6 GPUs) and defers useResource in deduplicated lists, which removes upstream the per-descriptor walk measured in 629; the RewindBox argument buffer patch written for 1.4.0 no longer applies and is retired. MVKConfiguration is unchanged from 1.4.0.
patchMarkers: RewindBox drawable ownership: taken by each present, guarded by _mtlDrawableLock
RewindBox cache size: entry sizes counted once and kept on each shader library
RewindBox mapped cache data: compressed MSL referenced in the mapped file, not copied
RewindBox cache load line: libraries read, MSL copied or referenced, pNext types seen
RewindBox cache keys: a cached library keeps the resource bindings a lookup reads, not the layout's table
RewindBox SPIR-V store: a shader module keeps its SPIR-V compressed and reflects each stage interface once
RewindBox descriptor writes: a view's matched base and a buffer's GPU address are read once
RewindBox SPIR-V spill: a shader module's compressed SPIR-V is kept in an unlinked temporary file, not in the heap
patchWhy: MVKPresentableSwapchainImage drawable ownership (KhronosGroup/MoltenVK#2791, open, no upstream fix): acquireAndSignalWhenAvailable released _mtlDrawable without a lock on the vkAcquireNextImageKHR thread while, with MeloNX's asynchronous queue submission, the image's earlier present read it and copied it into its Metal handler blocks on the submission thread (SIGSEGV objc_retain <- _Block_copy <- MTLDispatchListAppendBlock <- presentCAMetalDrawable, Super Mario 3D World, vsync unbounded, IPA 718). Each present now takes its drawable under _mtlDrawableLock and its completion handler releases it; acquisition releases nothing; nextDrawable is never called with the lock held. Model and sanitizer checks: test/melonx_moltenvk_drawable_ownership_test.py. Also (lot 9, second part): MVKPipelineCache::countData() counts each entry's serialized size once and keeps it on its shader library, so the size query RewindBox asks during play no longer serializes every entry again (IPA 718 Hogwarts: 2 461 ms for 4 667 entries). macOS bench run 42811818840: 480 queries 24.6-24.9 ms -> 2.1-2.7 ms, same 8 826 110 bytes and data hash, VK_INCOMPLETE kept for a short buffer, reload size equal. Also (lot 9, third part, RAM): a private pNext structure of VkPipelineCacheCreateInfo (sType 0x52425831, 'RBX1') makes vkCreatePipelineCache reference each library's compressed MSL in the caller's data instead of copying it into the heap (MVKCompressor keeps an external pointer; MVKShaderLibrary's copy keeps it, so merges into main keep the reference; any new compression or a load without the structure owns its bytes as before; the cache data written is byte-identical). RewindBox passes it for the main snapshot only and keeps that read-only mapping until main is destroyed (adapt_pipeline_cache_mapped_data, Core gate pipeline-cache-mapped-data: the mapping kept through play, the pause checkpoint and the close, released after main is destroyed, every read of it valid). macOS bench run 42818483337 (44 MB cache, 2 400 pipelines): +77.8 MiB at load copied, +32.4 MiB referenced; 246 vs 199 MiB after the pipelines; same bytes written, 0 missing, 0 SPIR-V compiled. Not measured on an iPhone. Fourth part (11 Nov, lot 9, diagnostic only): one info line per pipeline cache loaded from data, "RewindBox pipeline cache load: N shader libraries from B bytes; compressed MSL copied|referenced in the caller's data; pNext types ...". IPA 724 (Hogwarts, pid 49375): the load meant to be referenced had the footprint curve of the copied load of IPA 718 (2 060 -> 4 149 -> 3 596 MiB against 2 090 -> 4 256 -> 3 678), and nothing in the journals said how the driver had taken the data. No behaviour change. Fifth part (11 Nov, lot 10, RAM and pipeline cache size): a cached shader library is kept under SPIRVToMSLConversionConfiguration::cacheKey(), its configuration without the resource bindings no lookup can read a result from (matches() reads the used bindings of the entry stage; alignWith() gives a binding the used flag of the last matching binding, false when none matches: an unused binding is dropped unless a used one before it matches it). MeloNX declares 261 bindings for a vertex + fragment program and MoltenVK lists each once per Metal stage with argument buffers: 1 305 entries of 136 bytes kept per library, in memory and in the data (IPA 724 Hogwarts: 792.03 MiB for 4 669 libraries, 177 876 bytes each; the staging load and its merge held them twice, +1 078 then +913 MiB in 5 s; a save rewrote them all, 10.9 s at the pause). The compressed MSL the third part references is the small rest, which is why Core 721 showed nothing on the device. Data written before is read whole and kept as keys; data written with keys is read by a MoltenVK without this part (same format). The load line gains "resource bindings R read K kept". MVK_CONFIG_REWINDBOX_FULL_CACHE_KEYS in the environment keeps whole configurations (the control of test/melonx_cache_keys; nothing sets it in the app). Property test on MoltenVK's own matches() and alignWith(): test/melonx_cache_keys/cache_key_property_test.cpp. Not measured on an iPhone. Sixth part (17 Nov, RAM and pipeline creation): a shader module keeps its SPIR-V compressed with LZ4 (mvkCompress, the codec MoltenVK already uses for the MSL it retains, MVK_CONFIG_SHADER_COMPRESSION_ALGORITHM=3 set by MVKInitialization) instead of the words SPIRVToMSLConverter::setSPIRV copied, and decompresses a copy for each use: a conversion to MSL (a library no cache holds; a converter of its own for that conversion) and getSPIRV() (the tessellation reflection). IPA 764, Super Smash Bros. Ultimate (11 145 programs, 22 490 modules hashed, 177 conversions in the session): 695 MiB of the 1 350 MiB of live native heap were those copies, the first allocation site of the heap; IPA 759, Hogwarts Legacy: 205 MiB. Words LZ4 does not make smaller are kept as given. Also, MVKShaderModule::getShaderInterfaceVariables() reflects a stage interface (SPIRVReflection getShaderInputs/getShaderOutputs, into MVKGraphicsPipeline's own container type) once per module, storage class, stage and entry point and copies it out afterwards, where every graphics pipeline parsed and reflected its vertex shader's SPIR-V again (11 797 pipelines in that SSBU session). Not changed: what is converted, the conversion configuration, the libraries, the cache keys and data, the pipelines. MVK_CONFIG_REWINDBOX_RAW_SPIRV in the environment keeps the words as given (the control; nothing sets it in the app). Not measured on an iPhone. Seventh part (17 Nov, render thread): descriptor writes stop asking Metal for values that do not change. MVKImageViewPlane::getMTLTexture() remembers the view and the base texture it was found to match (recorded under the view's lock only if no creation or release happened since the check; cleared before the view is released) and returns the view at once for that same base, where matchesMTLTextureViewBase() sent two parentTexture messages each time, twice per texture descriptor; MVKBuffer reads its Metal buffer's GPU address once per binding (cleared on bind and detach); MVKSampler reads its sampler state's resource ID once; the Metal 3 argument buffer encoder uses them (the argument encoder mode is unchanged). IPA 764, Hogwarts Legacy courtyard (render thread profile at 14.6 FPS): 37 of 221 running samples inside mvkUpdateDescriptorSetWithTemplate, 16 under MVKImageViewPlane::getMTLTexture, 12 in the base comparison, 17 in the Objective-C runtime. Same descriptors written, same values. Not measured on an iPhone. Eighth part (17 Nov, RAM, every title): the stored bytes of a shader module's SPIR-V (LZ4, sixth part) go to an unlinked temporary file of the process (mkstemp in NSTemporaryDirectory, unlinked at once; pwrite at offsets taken atomically, pread for each use: a conversion to MSL, a stage interface reflection, the tessellation reflection) instead of staying in the heap; a module keeps them in memory when the file cannot be created or written or would pass 4 GiB. IPA 767, Super Smash Bros. Ultimate (22 490 modules, 177 conversions): the compressed words were still the first allocation site of the native heap, 358 of 1 023 MiB live (MVKShaderModule::setSPIRV); Hogwarts Legacy is ended by iOS in the castle courtyard at 4 % device available (footprint 4.9 GiB). Pages of a file are not part of the footprint and the system can drop them. Not changed: the bytes stored, what is converted, configurations, libraries, cache keys and data, pipelines. MVK_CONFIG_REWINDBOX_SPIRV_IN_MEMORY in the environment keeps them in memory (the control; nothing sets it in the app). Not measured on an iPhone.
